theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ q • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ q • (β (t • y)).curryLeft y) x + (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (exteriorDerivative β (t • x)).curryLeft x) = β x) → ∀ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1), ∃ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) q, ∀ x : Euclid P, ‖x‖ < ρ → (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (exteriorDerivative (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) (t • x)).curryLeft x) = (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x - exteriorDerivative (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) q) x
